question: Who is considered the ‘linchpin of the Government’?

options.text: Chief Justice of the Supreme Court

solution:
The correct answer is "**__Prime Minister__**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Prime Minister**__ is considered the ‘__**linchpin of the Government**__’.

 __
 
• Ministers may be chosen at the **Prime Minister**'s discretion.
 
• He served as the** Planning Commission's** former chairman and is the current leader of the country.
 
• The Prime Minister informs the President on all Council of Minister's areas pertaining to **Union management** and legislative problems.
 
• The Prime Minister presides over meetings of the** cabinet** as its chairman.
 
• The **Prime Minister** serves as a **liaison **between the **President** and the **Parliament** on one side, and the **Council of Ministers** on the other.
 
• The Prime Minister plays these functions, which is why **Pt. Nehru** called him "**the linchpin of Government**."
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 __**Post**__
 __**Description**__
 
 

 **President**
 The **head of state** of the Republic of India is the president. The president serves as the titular leader of the executive branch, the nation's **first citizen**, and the supreme **commander** of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
 

 **Chief Justice of the Supreme Court**
 The chief justice, who serves as the top justice of the Supreme Court, is **in charge** of assigning cases to** constitutional benches** that deal with significant legal issues.
 
 

 **Vice-President**
 After the president, the vice president holds the** second-highest constitutional post**, and he or she comes first in the line of succession to the presidency.
